mentions.name: MapVoyage
mentions.description: A mobile app for exploring places with Wikivoyage, nearing a beta version. It aims to unify the workflow of switching between Wikivoyage, the Google Maps favourites list, and notes into a single app.
mentions.problem: Going back and forth between Wikivoyage, the favourites list on Google Maps, and notes when exploring places.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a mobile app for exploring places with Wikivoyage (https://mapvoyage.app)
